article_content: The parents of the late New York Rangers player, Derek Boogaard, have decided to donate his brain to Boston University researchers. Boogaard, 28, was found deceased in his Minneapolis apartment, and while the cause of death is still unknown, his brain will be used to further research on the effects of trauma on the brain and spinal cord. Throughout his career, Boogaard played for the Minnesota Wild and the New York Rangers, and was also involved in charitable activities, such as the Defending the Blue Line Foundation.
